steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Fantastic, my friends!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Thanks for your courage! Thanks for sticking together!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: When the sky roars its verdict, freedom will be ours!
The crowd huddles by the window, staring intently into the night. And as if hearing their plea, soon thunder rolls across the heavens, making the ghostly lights flicker and dance.
A deluge is crashing down, thunder rumbling with fury!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Back up! Everyone, move back now!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: The thunder of justice— is about to strike!!
As the shout echoes, lightning and thunder strike the stage in an instant!
The burst of silver-white lightning reveals golden sparks. The dilapidated walls, no match for the heavenly "punishment," come tumbling down with a roar!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ?! Isn't that a bit too real for stage effects...?
Terrified, the audience instinctively takes cover behind you and Ignis. Meanwhile, the actors rush in—the divide between the confines and the outside world is now broken.
Luvia Ray, along with her fellow performers, stands on the rubble, shouting triumphantly.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Chief! No... I mean, everyone! Everyone! We've made it! We've succeeded!!!
The star of the show calls out, beckoning everyone to celebrate with her.
Those once confined, now tasting freedom, swarm towards their liberator, converging on the fallen debris.
Eagerly, they claw their way out of the rubble, looking to their leader to guide them further on their path to freedom.
Yet, Luvia Ray stands still upon the ruins, her gaze fixed in the distance, as if she is waiting for something or someone.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Ahem, but this is not enough.
While pretending to cough, Luvia Ray takes a quick, secretive look at her palm.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: What happens if someone spots us and figures out we're on the run?

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: That's true... Then, what should we do?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Fear not, I will guide us all to freedom! If you trust me, stand by my side; if you're scared, it's okay to leave first.
No sooner has the voice died away than the stage is overrun by a group with cameras and mics, clustering around Luvia Ray, with a barrage of flashbulbs going off.
Fortuna Prison's walls blown apart?!
These... wait, you, you're the prisoners from inside?!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Yikes! It's Mr. Reporter!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Can't believe you're bold enough to linger here! The guards must be on their heels by now!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Oh no—Mr. Reporter, you've got it all wrong! We're just a bunch of innocents who've been falsely accused!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: We've been pushed around, set up, and ended up here... You've got to help us out!
Luvia Ray, eyes fixed on the reporters swarming outside the wall, brings her hands together in a hopeful plea.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: This is a blockbuster story, right? Please... help us set up a press conference!
Luvia Ray steps out, positioning herself before the handful of "inmates" who have stayed with her.

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: We are the wild winds of rebellion!

steps.speaker: Culprit B
steps.content: We chase the fragrant aroma of freedom!

steps.speaker: Culprit C
steps.content: This is my own world!

Right in front of the "reporters," you witness the performers rally together. At this instant, every other noise fades away, leaving only the shouts for freedom and the sound of feet pounding the ground.
